findings.evidence: Lines 44–55 define these instances solely from `finiteExtensionValuativeRel`, `finiteExtensionNormedFieldTopology`, `finiteExtension_valuativeExtension`, and `finiteExtension_isNonarchimedeanLocalField`; they do not depend on any later declaration in `Ramification.lean`.
findings.fix: Move all four instances to `NegOne/Basic.lean` beside the carrier and its existing finite/separable structure, adding the narrow finite-extension import needed there.
findings.issue: The four `ValuativeRel`, `TopologicalSpace`, `ValuativeExtension`, and `IsNonarchimedeanLocalField` instances are foundational structure for `DyadicSqrtNegOne`, not ramification results; users of the carrier should not need the specialized computation module to obtain them.

summary: The ramification computations are appropriately grouped, but foundational local-field instances are placed too late in the specialized ramification module.
